label: Magicshine Controls
description: Control supported Magicshine lights from the Karoo app or the in-ride field, with lamp selection, quick beam switching, and battery and temperature telemetry.
releaseNotes:
* Hardened Karoo extension lifecycle against Appstore service restarts
* Prevented unhandled Karoo binder disconnects during extension shutdown
* Kept the standard Karoo Extensions Library update flow
